data.body: Merge-to-main follow-up: merge-to-main.sh completed PR1 (feature->staged #513) but could not push to staged-* (branch protection). Created staged->main PR #515. CI llm-review on #515 returned a TRUE-POSITIVE critical: the Axis-5 .sprint-active/.debug-active guard advertised earlier was NOT in the committed code (lost to a failed Edit + a /tmp snapshot restore that predated Axis 5). Root cause of the false-green: the active-markers test created markers as untracked files, so worktrees were kept as 'uncommitted changes' not by any guard — passing vacuously. FIX (commit 5d3a8f21c4): (1) restored Check 0 marker guard in is_claude_active (protects --all sweep) + is_claude_active gate in the targeted --worktree path; (2) hardened the test fixture to gitignore the markers via info/exclude so it now genuinely fails (3/4) without the guard. Re-review on #515 in progress. NOT merging until llm-review passes.
